reason: The mutation is the combination of (a) fusing the query low-rank dequantization, FP32 RMSNorm and RoPE/NoPE split into one decode kernel so three intermediate GM passes disappear, (b) replacing explicit contiguous clones on the LightningIndexer query/key inputs with stride-compliant aliases that satisfy the 32 B/512 B NPU alignment contract, and (c) keeping the top-k selected block indices and valid-length mask device-resident across the npu_lightning_indexer to sparse-MLA handoff so a -1 sentinel never becomes an AICore address and no host clamp is needed. The source-only status is deliberate: the transcripts establish the baseline copy/sync/fault signals and the kernels involved, but the three factors have not been run as a controlled baseline/full/leave-one-out experiment on one frozen service.

geometry.note: These are the observed V4-Flash C4 values. Re-derive them when the model, layer compression class or checkpoint differs; do not treat them as universal constants.

factors.change: Replace the decode query chain (dequantize qr to a temporary, RMSNorm to a second temporary, project with the W_UK-absorbed W_Q, split NoPE/RoPE, apply RoPE to the 64-wide slice, concat) with one fused kernel that reads int8 qr plus its per-token FP32 scale, dequantizes in FP32, applies the FP32 RMSNorm weight, multiplies by the absorbed W_Q, splits 512 NoPE and 64 RoPE in registers, applies RoPE only to the 64-wide slice, and writes one packed [T, H, 576] query.
invariants: W_Q contains the W_UK absorption for decode; the non-absorbed prefill path remains 128 + 64 and is not routed through this kernel.
The output width is 512 + 64 per head and the last dimension is contiguous.
RoPE touches only the 64-wide slice; accumulation is FP32; qr_scale is per token and rms_weight is FP32.
The output base satisfies the 32 B alignment contract and no intermediate qr/norm/split tensor is written to GM.
factors.expected_effect: Remove three intermediate GM passes per MLA layer and one launch chain per layer; lower decode TPOT and indexer-adjacent latency without changing the index scores beyond the unavoidable FP32/quantization ordering.
factors.removal_signature: The dequant, RMSNorm, split and concat TensorMove/Memcpy entries return and decode TPOT regresses, while the index scores stay equal.

factors.change: Replace explicit .contiguous() clones on q_indexer and k_indexer with stride-compliant slice views before npu_quant_lightning_indexer. The query view keeps the producer's axis-0 stride and storage offset, has stride(-1) == 1, and is 32 B aligned; the key view remains the PA_BSND paged index-key cache. Request offsets come from the device query_start_loc; a kernel rejection falls back to a copy outside the captured decode path.
invariants: No allocation and no .contiguous() in the captured forward.
data_ptr() is unchanged across the call; the last dimension is contiguous; the base and row stride satisfy the kernel's 32 B/512 B alignment contract.
The key cache stays PA_BSND with its original page strides; the block table stays int32 and axis-0 strided.
A view that is not accepted by the kernel is not forced; the fallback is recorded.
factors.expected_effect: Remove one token-scaled clone per layer and indexer call, reducing device bandwidth and decode TPOT with bitwise-equal index scores and top-k selections.
factors.removal_signature: The Q/K TensorMove clones return and TPOT regresses, while the top-k selections stay equal; a stride/contiguity error means the fallback boundary applies and the factor is not retained.

factors.change: Keep the selected top-k indices, the valid-length tensor and the block-table guard on the device. Clamp the valid count with a device op, replace the -1 sentinel with a safe allocated dummy block, scatter the guarded indices into a persistent device block table, and pass seqused_k so the dummy is excluded from attention. Remove the host clamp and .item()/.cpu() from the indexer-to-attention handoff; if a host scalar is unavoidable, compute it once in metadata/prepare outside capture.
invariants: -1 never reaches AICore; the dummy block is a real allocated block excluded by seqused_k or the mask.
seqused_k is int32 on the device and non-increasing per request when the context shrinks.
The block-table row length is at least topk and covers the padded capacity; no .item()/.cpu() occurs inside the captured step.
Graph replay observes the updated device buffers, not a stale host snapshot.
factors.expected_effect: Remove the D2H synchronization and host clamp, prevent invalid GM reads at long context, and stabilize TPOT when the selected block count changes across steps.
factors.removal_signature: The host clamp and D2H return; the adversarial long-context case exposes an invalid block id, a wrong selection, or an invalid GM address.

leave_one_out_arms.purpose: Capture the unmodified absorbed decode path with the same model, weights, topology, context lengths, concurrency and graph mode.
Measure the complete retained combination and require every correctness and performance gate to pass.
Must restore the dequant/RMSNorm/split copies and a decode TPOT regression while keeping index scores equal.
Must restore the Q/K contiguous clones and a TPOT regression while keeping top-k selections equal.
Must restore the host clamp/D2H and expose an invalid block id, a wrong selection, or an invalid GM address in the adversarial long-context case.

fused_q_qr_dequant_and_rope_split.baseline: Three or more token-scaled TensorMove/Memcpy entries per MLA layer around qr dequant, RMSNorm and the NoPE/RoPE split.
fused_q_qr_dequant_and_rope_split.candidate: One fused query kernel per layer and no intermediate GM tensors.
fused_q_qr_dequant_and_rope_split.removal_must_show: The copies return and decode TPOT regresses; index scores remain equal.

contiguous_view_alias_for_lightning_inde.baseline: A TensorMove/Memcpy immediately before npu_quant_lightning_indexer whose size scales with the token count.
contiguous_view_alias_for_lightning_inde.candidate: The indexer consumes an aliased view with the producer's data_ptr and axis-0 stride.
contiguous_view_alias_for_lightning_inde.removal_must_show: The clone returns and TPOT regresses; top-k selections remain equal.

device_resident_topk_block_mask_guard.baseline: A host clamp or .item()/.cpu() between npu_lightning_indexer and sparse MLA, and a -1 tail that can reach the attention operator.
device_resident_topk_block_mask_guard.candidate: Zero host D2H in the captured handoff and a device-side sentinel guard.
device_resident_topk_block_mask_guard.removal_must_show: The host clamp/D2H returns and the adversarial long-context case exposes an invalid block id or GM address.

acceptance: 1k greedy output matches the BF16 dense reference token for token.
32k and 128k accuracy stays within the pre-registered tolerance and long-context retrieval is not below baseline.
No AICore invalid GM address, cross-device timeout, NaN, graph recapture or host D2H inside the captured step.
A performance win must exceed twice the run-to-run spread and must appear in the long-context cells, not only at 1k.

fallback_boundary.non_absorbed_prefill: Factor 1 does not apply; keep the 128 + 64 prefill query and the kv_b_proj expansion. Factors 2 and 3 apply only when an indexer is present.
fallback_boundary.different_geometry: When kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim, indexer head_dim, topk, compress_ratio or the layer compression class differs, re-derive the widths and scale binding instead of reusing 512/64/128/512/4.
fallback_boundary.kernel_rejects_view: Keep .contiguous() at the call site or in metadata/prepare, report the copy and its size, and do not claim factor 2. A forced view that changes scores is a correctness regression.
fallback_boundary.per_tensor_c8: Factor 3's per-token scale assumption is invalid; use a consistent per-tensor store and load and do not mix granularities.
fallback_boundary.host_scalar_required: If an operator cannot consume a device valid-length tensor, keep the synchronization outside capture and report it; do not hide it inside replay.
fallback_boundary.different_soc: A2/A3 and A5 have different QLI tiling keys and bindings (torch.ops.custom versus torch.ops.cann_ops_transformer); re-check the available kernel, dtype and layout.
fallback_boundary.ablation_unproven: Until the full candidate and all three minus arms run on one frozen configuration, keep experiment_status as not_run_source_only and do not report a measured speedup.
